test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Matric Level) - GA (Held On 26 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: The Government has approved the continuation of pension for freedom fighters for financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26. What is the name of the scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swatantrata Sainik Samman Yojana (SSSY)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The** Swatantrata Sainik Samman Yojana is a scheme approved by the Government of India for providing pensions to freedom fighters.**
 
• This scheme **ensures** that those who fought for India's independence are recognized and financially supported.
 
• The **continuation of the pension for the financial years 2021-22 to 2025-26 was aimed** at honouring and aiding the remaining freedom fighters and their families.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **One Rank One Pension Scheme (OROP)**: This scheme pertains to providing equal pensions to retired military personnel of the same rank, irrespective of their retirement date. 
 
• **Veer Sainik Samman Yojna (VSSY)**: It is a focus on military veterans,
